scripts.ready: vp fmt && vp lint && pnpm test && vp run -r build
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm --dir docs exec wrangler versions upload --preview-alias preview --no-bundle
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @vue-doctor/core test && pnpm --filter vue-doctor test && pnpm --filter nitro-doctor test && pnpm --filter nuxt-doctor test && pnpm --filter vite-doctor test
scripts.release:version: changeset version && pnpm --dir packages/vite exec npm version 0.0.1 --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version
scripts.release:pack: mkdir -p artifacts && pnpm --filter vite-doctor... build && pnpm --filter vite-doctor pack --pack-destination artifacts
